pins.definition: School work that a student is given to do at home.
School work to be completed by a student outside of the classroom.
School tasks assigned by a teacher to be completed outside of class hours.

situation: A teenage girl sits at her bedroom desk late at night, staring at an open exercise book surrounded by textbooks.
subject: the school work assigned to be done at home
brief: A teenage girl sits at a tidy wooden desk under a warm desk lamp at night, resting her chin on one hand while holding a red pen over an open grid-paper exercise book filled with handwritten equations. Her school bag rests on the floor beside the chair, and a stack of thick textbooks sits nearby, perfectly capturing the quiet isolation of evening study.
